instrument: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV
citation: DGCA Civil Aviation Requirement, Section 3 — Air Transport, Series M, Part IV, Revision 4 (effective 15 February 2023): Facilities to be provided to passengers by airlines due to denied boarding, cancellation of flights and delays in flights.
amountBasis: The CAR sets each amount as the lesser of the tier amount and the one-way basic fare plus airline fuel charge, so the tier amount acts as a cap.

noticeBands.name: Cancellation with two weeks or more notice
noticeBands.note: Refund or alternate flight only. No cash compensation.

noticeBands.name: Cancellation with less than two weeks but more than 24 hours notice
noticeBands.note: Compensation payable where no acceptable alternate flight is offered within the prescribed window.

noticeBands.name: Cancellation with less than 24 hours notice
noticeBands.note: Compensation payable in addition to a full refund or re-accommodation.

tiers.label: alternate flight beyond 24 hours or declined

dutyOfCare.provision: Alternate flight within six hours, or a full refund
Hotel accommodation for flights scheduled between 20:00 and 03:00
